ustroystven-pravilnik-na-ministerstvoto-.note: Gazette material 118279 (lines 850-1458): the правилник itself ends at чл. 50 followed by the Приложение към чл. 16, ал. 2, with no own additional, transitional or final provisions; the §§ 1-3 in the Gazette (lines 810-818) are the ПЗР of adopting ПМС № 208/2017. The §§ lex.bg prints after чл. 50 (lines 710-737: § 4 ПМС 45/2019, § 3 ПМС 234/2019, § 3 ПМС 123/2020, § 13 ПМС 60/2021, Параграф единствен ПМС 16/2024, §§ 15-16 ПМС 119/2025) belong to later amending decrees, so the lowest § being 3 reflects amending-act §§, not a dropped provision of the act; the doubled 'Заключителни разпоредби' heading at lines 715-716 is a repeated heading only.
